generated: ned 13 sep 2026 15:50:55 CEST

Portable snapshot (banners embedded; phone-safe). Registered Kontakt libraries; click a name to jump. Update: on desktop re-run build-kontakt-catalog-html.sh both and re-transfer this file.

Legend

Legend for the catalog chrome. Cards stay in the content window; this key sits on its left border.

Collapsible sections below use the same words as the chrome: Search, Keywords, Index, Window, Embed, Sides, Middle, Flip, Collapse, Customize, Layouts, Profiles, PATH, Clear, S, K, About / Document, Expand controls, Snap 50/50, Lock separator, Side-by-side.

Symbols
  • PATH — small caps label above the three path icons on a card (FS, copy, folder). There is no expandable path field on the card; the full location opens in the path reader via FS.
  • Folder (folder-shaped icon) — themed path icon that opens the library folder in the file manager on desktop (Dolphin). Omitted or inert on portable.
  • Copy (overlapping-squares/duplicate icon) — path icon that copies the library location. A short toast confirms.
  • FS (up/down arrow icon, not the text "FS") — path icon that opens the path reader (long location). This is not the card’s own ⛶. Back closes the reader.
  • ♡ / ♥ — Favorite on the card, gallery, and image focus. Filled when the library is saved locally.
  • 💬 — appears next to Favorite only on cards with a saved note. Tap it to switch the description between the library’s own text and your note (never both, so card height does not change). Styled like the other card buttons.
  • 📝 My notes (embedded toolbar) — memo-pad icon beside the Favorite/heart button on an expanded card whose Card Search embed is open. Opens the same note editor as 💬 and scrolls it into view; shown only while that card’s embed is open, since the card’s own 💬 sits lower on the card and can be out of reach with the embed filling the view.
  • ▾ / ▴ Toolbar hide/show (embedded view) — a pair of small pill-shaped arrows nested against the card’s top edge, one for the card’s own toolbar row and one for the embed’s search/video toolbar row below it. Filled with the accent color while the toolbar it controls is showing; becomes an empty outline-only button once that toolbar is hidden, so the shown/hidden state reads at a glance. Only appears on the embedded-card toolbars (Card Search open) — the plain expanded/preview card view without an embed does not use this hide/show pair.
  • Index Window — Index docks as a scrollable window on the content pane and fills down to About / Document until you Collapse the index. Cards stay underneath; it does not overlay an expanded or front card. Skip-to-top / skip-to-bottom hide while Window is open.
  • Index Embed — the same list is placed with the catalog cards and scrolls away with them. The Index button reads Window when Embed is on (tap to return to Window) and Embed when Window is on.
  • Index arrow — opens Index. It stays closed until you use that arrow. Collapse on an open Window returns the pane to cards.
  • Skip to top / bottom — compact filled skip icons (bar + shaft + solid triangle; no “top” / “bottom” text). They sit just left of the content scrollbar with a small leftover so the track stays selectable. Work in Sides, Middle, and content-only. Stay put while cards scroll.
  • Flip — swaps Search and Keywords (Sides: skip-center around the catalog; Middle: mirror the pair). Portrait Sides swaps the menu column with content.
  • ⛶ — Open fullscreen. On an expanded card (desktop): card overlay. On Search / Keywords strips: that menu — ⛶ stays on the right; Keywords fullscreen has no back arrow. On Legend / Guide (desktop): the help card fills the viewport. Hidden on portable card chrome (phone goes straight to fullscreen popups). Distinct from path FS.
  • ⤢ Fullscreen (card search) — small diamond-shaped double arrow, one pointing up-right and one down-left (renders as tofu on some fonts — look for it on the Card Search stage if the glyph itself does not show). A different icon from the ⛶ square-corners fullscreen used elsewhere: it sits on the Card Search stage (the in-card Google / YouTube / image search opened from an expanded card) and expands that stage, video + comments pane included, to fill the screen. ↻ Reload (circular arrow) next to it reloads the current result; a blocked YouTube embed instead shows a ↺ Try again button (counter-clockwise circular arrow + text).
  • › / ‹ Expand controls — small chevron on a fullscreened Search or Keywords pane; › reveals a small strip with ⊞ Snap 50/50 (squared-plus icon; even the Search/Keywords split when both are fullscreened side by side) and, on the Search side only, 📌 Lock separator (pushpin icon; stop that split from being dragged — not offered from the Keywords strip). The chevron flips to ‹ while that strip is open, same idea as the Comments pane tab below.
  • 🔍 Side-by-side — magnifying-glass icon: while Search is fullscreened, a text K toggle brings Keywords in beside it; while Keywords is fullscreened, this 🔍 magnifier toggle brings Search in beside it. Off returns to one pane alone.
  • ‹ Comments pane tab — a small left-pointing arrow on a thin seam bar attached to a YouTube card-search result, which hides or shows the comments pane (see Card Search below); it flips to the mirrored right-pointing arrow when the pane is hidden.
  • ⋯ — overflow. Header / Search More parks extra tools (Clear on miss, scale, theme, Customize, Layouts, Profiles — max 12). On portable Keywords, ⋯ shows or hides category pills at the top of the pills window as transparent UI buttons — not a nested popup.
  • Clear (sweep icon) — clears Search + Keywords filters together. Clear on miss — if you leave gallery on a library that is not a current hit, Search clears.
  • H — History (session AC, saved sessions, saved combinations).
  • S / K header toggles — the header's Search and Keywords show/hide buttons render as a magnifying-glass icon (Search) and a tag-shaped icon (Keywords), not the letters "S"/"K" — those only remain as the button's title/aria-label. Hiding both on portable is content-only (catalog pane alone). Do not confuse with the still-textual K / 🔍 side-by-side companion toggles used inside a fullscreened Search or Keywords pane (see 🔍 Side-by-side).
  • ← Back — one step back from expanded card, card fullscreen, gallery, description/path reader, Search fullscreen, embed, or this Legend/Guide. Keywords fullscreen uses ⛶ + Hide instead of a back arrow.
  • − Minimize — minus-sign icon on an expanded/selected card's top-right chrome; docks that card as a small pill in the Pinned pyramid at the bottom of the content window instead of closing it.
  • × Close pinned card — small x on a pinned-dock pill; removes just that pill (does not affect Favorite or any saved note).
  • ◂ / ▸ aux collapse — desktop-only chevron in the header that hides or shows the Clear on miss, Layouts, and Profiles controls as a group, to free up header width; flips direction to show which state you're in.
  • Index height handle — thin drag bar under an open Index window (no glyph); drag its bottom edge to resize how much of the content pane the Index list takes up. Only draggable while Customize is on and layout is not pinned.
  • Legend / Guide — left-edge keys on the content border, docked like the skip icons. Selected sticks out further. They hide when the content window is not on screen and must not overlay About / Document. They also hide under card overlays unless help itself is open.
  • ▼ / ▲ tabs — two small tabs on the content window’s bottom border hide or show the Legend / Guide pair (left) and the skip-to-top / skip-to-bottom pair (right). They stay fully inside the content window. On phone they sit a quarter of the way in from each side (not on the edges) in both orientations, so they never crowd the edge controls.
Fields
  • Search — field placeholder “Search libraries…”. Name / other / patch tokens. Does not auto-open a front card. Hits highlight in the content window.
  • Suggestion list (session AC) — lives in the Search column under the field. Groups can include libraries, keyword hits, Patch names, session pins, and saved combinations. Session only until you save. Resize edges show in Customize.
  • Keyword pills — Instrument / Brand / Model / Vibe / Patch groups. Combine to narrow. Active filters also appear as Search pills. Libraries whose name uses a non-English or obscure instrument word also carry the English keyword (e.g. Floete → flute, Xilo → xylophone, Gjallar Horn → horn), so the English search term finds them. Portable ⋯ reveals the category buttons at the top of this window.
  • Two-line name — library title uses a fixed two-line slot with ellipsis (.lib-name). Hover (desktop) can show the full name in a themed bubble. Tap/click the name in the grid to open the expanded card (desktop) or the fullscreen popup (phone); ⛶ on the expanded card goes fullscreen. Portable portrait splits the document title around the notch, each word centered in its half.
  • Path — three icons under the cover (FS | copy | folder), not an expandable path field. FS opens the reader for the full location.
  • Description — blurb on the card; tap / wheel to open the description reader instead of stretching the grid.
  • Patch search / Patches — Patch category in Keywords, plus nested patch tree on the card (DS: grouped by subfolder). Kontakt stays library-level; Patch pills still match preset-name tokens when present. Collapse evens card heights.
  • Card Search — in-card Google / YouTube / image search when a card is expanded (embed vs popup depends on portable). A YouTube result adds a comments pane beside (wide) or under (split) the video; a thin seam tab toggles it away and back. In landscape it always sits beside the video (wide), even while playing; portrait drops it below (split) once a video is playing. Collapsing the pane while the layout has room lets the video stage expand into the freed space; the tab still works the same in fullscreen.
Content window
  • Cards — one library each, in the middle pane. Grid is the catalog. Expanded card is the desktop preview (centered, dimmed catalog behind). Portable/phone opens a fullscreen popup instead.
  • Covers — banner art. Tap for gallery / image focus, from either the expanded card or the fullscreen card. A − / + zoom bar with a drag slider between them sits at the bottom of that view to resize the image; it does not affect the card itself.
  • Desktop hover can enlarge the cover without leaving the grid.
  • Index (alphabetical) — name list. Closed until the Index arrow. Window fills down to About until Collapse and does not overlay an expanded/front card. Embed scrolls with cards. Click a name to jump.
  • About / Document — generation stamp and rebuild note at the foot. Window docks it under Index; Embed scrolls it with the cards. Legend / Guide keys sit above it, not on top of it.
  • Pinned pyramid — tap − Minimize on an expanded/selected card to dock it at the bottom of the content window (Save on Middle) instead of closing it. A cover-sized frame holds the still cover and, while playing, the video in the same spot, so the pill keeps its width and the name / × close button never shift. Reopening a pinned card always shows it, even if a filter or search would otherwise have hidden it.
  • Skip icons — bottom-right of this pane, just left of the scrollbar gutter.
Menu windows
  • Search — left (Sides landscape) or top (Middle / portrait). Field, suggestion list, pills, ⛶, Hide Search, Clear, History, scale.
  • Keywords — right (Sides landscape) or paired with Search on Middle. Pills, Hide Keywords, ⛶ on the right, Collapse, Customize, Layouts. Landscape Sides: header K opens Keywords as its own full side column (not stacked with Search). The Keywords collapse arrow then toggles nest: ▼ (down, full side) nests under Search when Search is on; nested ▲ (up) returns to the full Sides column. That arrow does not hide Keywords — header K (or Hide) turns Keywords off. Portrait Sides: menus already nest on a side, so the collapse arrow is the old one-step hide/show. Portable ⋯ toggles category pills as transparent buttons at the top of the pills window (not a popup). Fullscreen keeps ⛶; no back arrow.
  • Sides — Search | content | Keywords as three panes on landscape (Flip equivalent swaps the menu columns around the catalog). Landscape nest (▼ on Keywords) stacks Search above Keywords in one column, content the other; nested ▲ returns to the full column. Portrait already stacks menus on a side. Content is the only scrolling card window.
  • Middle — Search + Keywords on top, catalog below. On phone (portable always uses phone chrome), Middle is portrait-only; landscape uses Sides.
  • Content-only — Search and Keywords hidden (S and K off). The catalog pane fills; skip icons still work. Portable can live here even on a wide screen.
  • Portrait vs landscape — desktop ≥900px still uses Sides/Middle. Landscape Sides is three columns unless the Keywords collapse arrow nests KW under Search. Portrait stacks menus (Sides) or keeps Search | Keywords above cards (Middle); portrait collapse arrow stays one-step hide/show. Portable portrait titles split around the notch.
  • Portable = phone — *-portable.html always uses phone chrome (CATALOG_PORTABLE), even on a wide screen: menus as sheets / fullscreen, preview as popup.
  • Separators (Search split, dual-FS, Index height, and the nested Search/Keywords divider) drag only while Customize is on.
Mode buttons
  • S / K — Search / Keywords visibility (header). Landscape Sides: K opens Keywords as its own column, never nested under Search. Both off = content-only.
  • Sides / Middle — layout pick (persisted per catalog ns + orientation). Phone Middle is portrait-only.
  • Flip — swap the menu columns / stacked order. Landscape nested Sides: Flip moves the Search+Keywords pair together.
  • Collapse — close open patch trees, even card row heights, and (with Index Window open) collapse the index so cards return.
  • Customize — reveal drag edges for Search, Keywords, Index, and menu height. In Middle layout both the Search pane and the Keywords pane show a centred drag line on their bottom edge, so either one can set the menu height. Becomes Done while arranging.
  • Layouts — named menu size presets (Search + Keywords vs Search-only stores). Saved layouts, not the live session.
  • Profiles — saved workspace snapshots (pills, Flip, related chrome). Max 12 per catalog. Desktop header; phone parks it in ⋯. Portable hides the standing header control.
  • Theme picker — Desert Dusk, Night Studio, Smoked Glass, seasonal light/dark sets, HC Dark / HC Light. Saved as catalog-theme.
  • Pick / Search — data mode for Keywords vs typed Search.
  • Default — reset live splitter sizes without deleting named Layouts.
About / Document

About / Document is the collapsible note at the foot of the content window. Window keeps it docked under Index; Embed scrolls it with the cards. Legend / Guide edge keys and skip icons sit above this bar, not over it.

The catalog About / Document note lives at the foot of the content window (Window or Embed).

User guide for the catalog. Each block is a task: goal, steps, what you should see.

Notes on a library

Goal

Keep a personal note on a library, view it in place of the description, and have it feed search.

Steps

  1. Open a card (⛶ or tap its name) and tap the 💬 balloon next to the title to write a note, then Save.
  2. Back in the grid, that card shows a 💬 button next to Favorite. Tap it to swap the description between your note and the library's own text.
  3. Only catalog-recognized words in your note (the same Instrument / Brand / Model / Vibe / Patch vocabulary used everywhere else) become searchable keyword pills automatically, and count toward existing pills where they match. Write full sentences freely - unrelated words are ignored and never turn into pills.

You should see

The 💬 button only appears when a note is saved. Notes (and the recognized keywords they contribute) live in this browser's localStorage and are not part of the HTML file. Erase them from History → User text (notes).

Place the quick toolbar (phone)

Goal

Park the floating S / K / ⇄ toolbar where it does not get in the way, and have it remembered for every way you use the screen.

Steps

  1. Hide the header bar (or turn on Customize) so the toolbar shows.
  2. Press and hold the toolbar for about 3 seconds until it lifts, then drag. Dock markers appear on the edges and on the seam between the menu and the content window (or between the two menus).
  3. Drop it on a seam to dock it there, or anywhere else to leave it free. Repeat for each way you use the screen: Search up, Keywords up, both, neither, flipped, portrait, landscape.

You should see

A docked toolbar rides along when you drag the separator. Each combination of orientation, visible menus and Flip keeps its own spot: switch menus and the toolbar jumps to where you last left it for that combination, and comes back when you switch again. Positions are saved on this device.

Find a library by Search

Goal

Jump to one library by name (or patch token) without opening a random front card.

Steps

  1. Turn S on if Search is hidden.
  2. Click Search libraries… and type. Session AC lists matches under the field.
  3. Pick a suggestion or press through hits in the content window. Click the card you want. Clear wipes query + pills together.

You should see

The AC list stays in the Search column. Cards in the content window filter/highlight. Nothing auto-opens as an expanded card.

Filter by Keywords

Goal

Narrow the grid with Instrument / Brand / Model / Vibe / Patch pills.

Steps

  1. Turn K on. Open Keywords if the pane is hidden.
  2. On portable, tap ⋯ to show category buttons at the top of the pills window (transparent UI, not a popup). Tap ⋯ again to hide them.
  3. Choose a category, then tap pills. Combine freely. Switch Pick vs Search mode if you are hunting inside the pill set.
  4. Sweep Clear when you want the full set again. Chosen pills stay until Clear. Landscape Sides: header K / Hide turns the pane off; the Keywords down/collapse arrow (▼) nests under Search; the nested up arrow (▲) restores the 3-pane side (it does not hide). Portrait Sides: that same collapse arrow is one-step hide/show.

You should see

Pills accent when active. The content window only shows matching cards. Search pills row mirrors active filters. On Decent Sampler, expand a library to see patches grouped by subfolder.

Open a card / expanded card

Goal

Read one library without losing the catalog behind it.

Steps

  1. Click the card (name / body) in the grid.
  2. Desktop: you get an expanded card (preview). Portable/phone: a fullscreen popup.
  3. Use cover for gallery, description for the reader, PATH icons for folder / copy / FS, card Search for YouTube / web / images.
  4. Desktop ⛶ on the card enters fullscreen. ← Back from fullscreen returns to the expanded card; Back again returns to the grid.

You should see

Desktop: catalog dimmed, card centered, Back left, ⛶ right, two-line name in its slot. Phone: full window, Back left, no extra ⛶ on that surface. Index Window does not sit on top of this card. Collapse evens card sizes after you open patch trees.

Path icons

Goal

Copy or open a library location, or read a long path, without mixing that up with card fullscreen.

Steps

  1. On the card, find the PATH row: three icons — FS | copy | folder. There is no expandable path field.
  2. Folder opens Dolphin (desktop HTML only). Copy toasts the clipboard. FS opens the path reader for the full location — Back closes it.
  3. Card ⛶ (expanded-card chrome) is a different control: overlay fullscreen of the library, not the path reader.

You should see

Icons follow the theme (not a black raster). Index Window does not show PATH icons on its own rows. Portable has no desktop folder-open.

Index Window vs Embed

Goal

Use the alphabetical list without covering Search, then choose dock vs in-flow.

Steps

  1. Click the Index arrow — the list stays closed until you do.
  2. Leave Embed off for Window. The list fills the content pane down to About / Document until you Collapse.
  3. Press Embed to park the list with the cards and scroll it in-flow. The button then reads Window.
  4. Click a name to jump to that card. Opening an expanded/front card hides Window so it does not overlay that card.

You should see

Window fills down to the About bar. Embed sits in the card column. Search/Keywords chrome stays put. Skip icons hide while Index Window is open. The preference is remembered.

Sides vs Middle vs content-only

Goal

Choose whether menus hug the catalog, sit above it, or hide so only cards remain.

Steps

  1. Header: Sides — Search | content | Keywords (landscape 3-pane). Header K always opens Keywords as its own side, not stacked with Search.
  2. Middle — Search and Keywords on top, catalog below. On phone, Middle is portrait-only (landscape stays Sides).
  3. Use S / K to show or hide a menu. Landscape Sides K opens Keywords solo on its side. Both off is content-only — catalog pane alone, skip icons still work.

You should see

The active layout button accents. Content pane border is where Legend/Guide and skip icons live. Pick is stored for this catalog + orientation. Portable always uses phone chrome, even on a wide monitor.

Keywords nest under Search

Goal

On landscape desktop Sides, stack Keywords under Search in one column, then restore the full 3-pane side — without hiding Keywords.

Steps

  1. Desktop landscape, Sides, Search on. Press header K — Keywords opens as its own full side column (Search | content | Keywords, or Flip equivalent).
  2. Press the Keywords panel collapse arrow (▼ while Keywords is a full side — not header K). Search sits on top, Keywords on the bottom, same column; content is the other pane.
  3. Press the nested up arrow (▲) to return to 3-pane Sides. Header K (or Hide) turns Keywords off.
  4. Portrait desktop Sides already nests menus on a side — that collapse arrow stays one-step hide/show. Do not expect the landscape nest-toggle there. If Search is off in landscape, the nest arrow does not invent a Search column.

You should see

Full-side Keywords shows a down/collapse arrow meaning nest under Search. Nested Keywords shows an up arrow meaning return to the full Sides column. Nested Flip moves Search+Keywords together. Nested Customize keeps a movable divider between Search and Keywords. Portable phone chrome is unchanged. Portrait desktop still one-step hide — no up-arrow nest-toggle there.

Flip

Goal

Swap which side Search vs Keywords occupy, without changing filters.

Steps

  1. Press Flip (header / layout cluster).
  2. Landscape Sides: menus skip the center catalog. If Keywords is nested under Search, Flip moves that stacked pair together. Landscape Middle: the top pair mirrors.
  3. Portrait Sides: Flip swaps the stacked Search+Keywords column with the content window. Portrait Middle: Flip only swaps the two menu columns; cards stay below.

You should see

Search and Keywords trade places. The content window does not dump its cards. Flip can be stored in a Profile and in localStorage per layout scope.

Portrait / landscape

Goal

Keep Sides/Middle usable when the window is tall vs wide.

Steps

  1. Desktop is min-width 900px. Rotate or resize across that.
  2. Landscape: three columns (Sides) or menus-above (Middle). Sides Keywords ▼ nests under Search; nested ▲ restores the 3-pane; header K hides Keywords.
  3. Portrait: menus stack on a side (Sides) or stay above cards (Middle). The Keywords collapse arrow keeps one-step hide/show — not the landscape nest-toggle. Extra header tools go behind ⋯ if they overflow. Portable splits the title around the notch — each word centered in its half.

You should see

Cards remain in the content window. Legend/Guide stay on that pane’s left edge, not on Search. Display mode is independent of theme.

Portable

Goal

Use the phone file as a phone, even on a large screen.

Steps

  1. Open *-portable.html — always phone, even on a wide screen.
  2. Treat preview, documents, Search, and Keywords as fullscreen sheets. Back exits that sheet. Keywords fullscreen keeps ⛶ on the right and has no back arrow; Hide still works.
  3. Do not expect desktop Profiles in the header; use ⋯ where the phone menu lists Customize / Layouts / Profiles (max 12).

You should see

No extra ⛶ on the Legend/Guide surface. Path folder-open is desktop-only. Banners in portable are embedded in the file. Skip icons and Legend / Guide hide when the content window is off-screen or another overlay is up, then return.

Customize separators

Goal

Resize Search, Keywords, and Index by dragging edges, then keep or reset those sizes.

Steps

  1. Press Customize (Keywords tools). Edges become live. The button reads Done while arranging.
  2. Drag the Search split, dual-FS separator, AC height/width, Keywords height, Index height. On landscape nested Sides, the divider between Search and Keywords stays movable. Pin locks a separator. Snap 50/50 when both menus are fullscreen together.
  3. Default resets sizes. Layouts saves/applies a named preset (separate from the live session).

You should see

Customize stays accented while edit is on. Without it, separators ignore pointer so you cannot nudge layout by accident. Live sizes persist in localStorage for this catalog namespace.

History

Goal

Revisit or erase Search AC history without deleting named Layouts.

Steps

  1. Open Search so the AC shell is visible. Press H (or Search ⋯ → History on compact chrome).
  2. Pick rows, or All search (typed history only) vs All (includes saved sessions and saved combinations). Neither button ticks User text (notes) — that row must be checked by hand.
  3. Press ✓ once to arm it (✓ and ✕ turn red as a warning); press ✓ again to actually erase, or press ✕ to back out without erasing. Changing any checkbox while armed disarms it again.

You should see

History cloud over the Search dropdown. The top label reads "Erase history + User text" while that box is checked. Session AC is not a saved Layout or Profile until you store it. Erasing search history does not reset theme or Flip unless you chose All including saved sessions/combinations. Erasing User text clears every saved note (and the keyword pills it generated) on this device — it cannot be undone.

Profiles

Goal

Snapshot workspace (pills, Flip, related chrome) and switch later. Cap is 12 profiles per catalog.

Steps

  1. Header Profiles (or ⋯ on phone). Save the current setup. The list refuses a 13th; replace or delete one first.
  2. Switch profiles from the list. Reload the page — the active one should return.
  3. Theme can still be changed from the theme picker; it stores as catalog-theme.

You should see

A standing Profiles button on desktop; phone parks it in ⋯. Portable hides this header control. Max 12 snapshots, localStorage only.

Fullscreen menus

Goal

Give Search or Keywords the whole menu surface, then return.

Steps

  1. On the Search strip, press ⛶ — Search fullscreen. Exit with ⛶ again or Hide Search.
  2. On Keywords, press ⛶ the same way. ⛶ stays on the right. There is no back arrow on Keywords fullscreen. Hide Keywords still shows/hides the pane.
  3. Companion S / K can bring the other menu back beside it.

You should see

The other column yields space. Dual-FS may hide some skip chrome. Flip must not block one-menu fullscreen.

Back from embed / preview

Goal

Leave overlay without dumping the catalog session.

Steps

  1. From a card Search embed: Back leaves the embed; another Back leaves the preview if you are still expanded.
  2. From desktop card fullscreen: Back → expanded card → grid.
  3. From portable preview or document popup: Back exits that popup.
  4. Gallery, description reader, path reader, Legend/Guide fullscreen: same one-step Back.

You should see

Each Back peels one layer. Filters, Sides/Middle, and scroll position of the grid remain. Session AC is still there; Index stays however you left it.

Legend / Guide widgets

Goal

Read this legend or the guides without leaving Sides / Middle / content-only.

Steps

  1. On the left content border, tap the key widget (Legend) or the book-with-? widget (Guide). They dock like the skip icons.
  2. Guide opens on the User guide tab (default). Switch to Update guide for rebuild / refresh.
  3. Desktop: ⛶ on the help card goes fullscreen. Back steps out. The same edge keys stay available while help is open.
  4. Scroll this card — each section is a details block. Close help with Back, or tap the active edge key again.

You should see

A long scrollable card (this text). Guide tabs appear only for Guide. The keys hide when the content window is not on screen, and they sit above About / Document rather than covering it. Overlay cards hide them until you close those overlays.

Update guide — how this catalog file is rebuilt, what persists, and what to do when chrome sticks. There is no separate changelog file in the repo; chrome notes live here.

Rebuild / refresh

Re-run the catalog builder for this library set, then reload the page. Desktop and portable HTML are separate files.

  • Scripts live under kiro/specs/kontakt-workspace-drive-dirty-fix/artifacts/. Mode argument: desktop | portable | both.
  • Decent Sampler. After adding libraries, run build-ds-catalog-html.sh both. Output is library-level: expand a library to see patches grouped by subfolder.
  • Kontakt. Registered libraries come from komplete.db3 (Kontakt Portable UserData, content_type=2). Rebuild with build-kontakt-catalog-html.sh only when that database is the real studio file — this patch tree cannot see /mnt/workspace from every machine.
  • Builders write artifact HTML. Copy the new files into public/catalogs/ (KONTAKT-CATALOG.html, DS-CATALOG.html, and the matching *-portable.html), then reload. Serve from http://127.0.0.1:8797/.
  • A rebuild refreshes cards, covers, descriptions, and Index. It does not wipe localStorage theme, layouts, or profiles.
Recent changes (this week)
  • YouTube comments pane — a card search video result now carries a collapsible comments list beside it (wide layouts) or under it (split/narrow), with a seam tab to hide/show, and the video stage expands to fill the space when the pane is collapsed. Works the same fullscreened.
  • Pinned-dock pill fix — the minimized-card pill no longer reflows or misaligns its name / close button when a video starts or stops playing; the cover and the video now share one fixed-size frame instead of the video pushing a new item into the pill row.
  • Pinned-card restore fix — reopening a card from the pinned dock while a filter/search had it hidden now always shows it, instead of occasionally opening to nothing until the filter changed again.
  • Smoother custom scrollbar — the hover-scroll thumb (the shadow scrollbar beside the native one) is now positioned with a compositor-only transform instead of a layout-triggering style, so it should not lag behind fast scrolling on long columns.
  • Quick toolbar (phone) — remembers a separate dock/position per orientation and per combination of visible menus (Search / Keywords / Flip / Middle); see Place the quick toolbar in the User guide.
  • Expanded keyword vocabulary — Instrument/Brand pills now also cover ethnic/world instruments (oud, sitar, koto, guzheng, pipa, shamisen, darbuka, vibraphone, timpani, tambourine, and more) and additional real library vendors (Soundiron, Sonokinetic, SubMission Audio, Output, Soniccouture, GetGood Drums, FluffyAudio, Nami Audio, EarthMoments, 8Dio, Streamtech Music), auto-matched from each library's own name against the same rule set (no invented categories). The library updater and live builder scripts tag new libraries with this expanded set automatically going forward.
  • Note keywords now vocabulary-only — free-text notes used to turn almost every 3+ letter word into a searchable pill; a saved note now only contributes pills for words that already exist in the catalog's own Instrument/Brand/Model/Vibe/Patch vocabulary. Write full sentences in a note and only the relevant catalog terms inside them become pills.
  • English keyword aliases, a Middle-mode Keywords bottom border, centred mobile hide/show tabs, and note-button alignment/UX polish also landed this week.
After a new catalog drop
  1. Replace this HTML (and the sibling portable/desktop file if you use both).
  2. Hard-reload the tab so the browser does not keep a stale multi-megabyte file.
  3. Theme, Layouts, Profiles (max 12), Favorites, and UI scale stay in localStorage — they are not inside the HTML drop.
  4. If path icons or covers look wrong, confirm you copied the matching thumbs / portable embed, not only one file.
Portable vs desktop files
  • KONTAKT-CATALOG.html / DS-CATALOG.html — desktop thumbs, [open folder] where the OS allows, Sides three-pane on wide landscape, desktop Profiles in the header.
  • KONTAKT-CATALOG-portable.html / DS-CATALOG-portable.html — self-contained, banners embedded, phone chrome always (window.CATALOG_PORTABLE / body.catalog-portable). Middle is portrait-only; landscape uses Sides. Content-only hides Search and Keywords.
  • Do not mix: a portable file on a 1400px monitor still behaves as phone (fullscreen popups, no desktop card ⛶ on Legend/Guide). Bookmark the file you actually use.
localStorage: theme, layouts, scale
  • Theme — catalog-theme (default Desert Dusk).
  • UI scale — catalog-ui-scale-kontakt / catalog-ui-scale-ds, plus Search-only scale keys.
  • Layouts — named Search / Keywords sizes from the Layouts menu. Customize drag edges write live ratios separately from those names.
  • Flip — catalog-sides-portrait-flip-* per catalog namespace and layout scope.
  • Index Embed — remembered Window vs Embed.
  • Profiles — catalog-user-profiles-*, max 12.
  • Header bar — hide/show document header. While it is hidden (or Customize is on) a small floating quick toolbar appears with S (Search), K (Keywords), ⇄ Flip, layout and a collapse arrow.
  • Quick toolbar docking (phone) — long-press the toolbar (about 3 s) to drag it; dock markers appear on the screen edges and on every seam between two panes (menu | menu, or menu | content window). Drop it on a seam and it stays glued there, following the separator when you resize. Each layout combination — orientation, which of Search / Keywords is up, Flip — remembers its own position separately, so once you have placed the toolbar for a combination it comes back there automatically whenever that combination returns. Dropping it away from a seam remembers that free spot for the current combination instead. Docked to a side edge, the bar turns into a vertical column and its ⇄ Flip glyph rotates 90° to match.
  • Clearing site data for this origin resets chrome. Rebuilding HTML does not.
Session vs saved
  • Saved (localStorage, per catalog ns) — theme, Sides/Middle pick, Flip, Customize sizes, Layouts, Profiles (max 12), Favorites, notes, UI scale, Index/About Embed prefs, some Search-split ratios, Clear on miss, quick toolbar position and docks (one per layout combination).
  • Session — typed Search AC list until you save a session/combination; open expanded card; Legend/Guide open state; Index open/closed this visit (arrow still required to open).
  • History All search erases typed history only. History All also targets saved sessions and saved combinations — not theme and not named Layouts unless those were stored as combinations.
  • Closing the tab keeps saved keys. A private window will look like a first run.
Troubleshooting
  • Hard-refresh. Reload ignoring cache after a new drop (large DS file especially). Confirm the URL is 127.0.0.1:8797/… so you are not on an old copy. Stale JS from a previous paste is the usual “buttons do nothing” cause.
  • Search not opening. Press header S. If Hide Search was used, show it again. If a card/gallery/Legend is fullscreen, Back first (Search is parked behind overlays). Then click the field; AC should list under it, not as a front card. In Middle + Flip, if Search is zero-width: Customize → Default.
  • Layout stuck. Customize off? Edges will not drag. Press Default, or Layouts → a known preset. Unpin a locked separator. Flip once and back if Sides/Middle look mirrored. Profiles can restore a saved chrome snapshot. Last resort: clear this origin’s localStorage (you will lose theme and saved layouts).
  • Index empty / closed — use the Index arrow. Product default is closed. Window should fill down to About; Collapse returns cards. If Window covers a front card, close the card overlay — Window is supposed to hide then.
  • Missing libraries. Desktop file out of date — rebuild from komplete.db3 (Kontakt) or rescan DS library folders, then replace the file you serve.
  • Folder icon does nothing. You are on portable, or the path is not on this machine. Use Copy instead. PATH is icons-only; FS opens the reader.
  • Legend / Guide missing. The content window must be on screen (Sides, Middle, or content-only). Edge keys hide during card overlays and must not cover About; close preview / gallery first.
  • Skip icons missing or covering the scrollbar. They are filled skip-to-top / skip-to-bottom squares, not “↑ top” text. They hide while Index Window is open. They should leave a small gap so the scrollbar track stays clickable.
About stamp

The About / Document body (generation time, rebuild one-liner) is the live stamp for this file. Same text is reused under Legend → About / Document. No standalone changelog in this repository; this Update guide is the in-catalog record.
